evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report description says processing slowed in the US from 25 July 06:30 Pacific. End: Description says processing of new events was normal again on 27 July 13:45. Regions: Report lists only the US multi-region as the affected location.
notes: Only location is the Google Cloud multi-region 'us', which is not a region, so no region code and scope unclear. Published date is the Mini Incident Report post (31 Jul 2023 15:08 PDT). Report's official Incident End of 29 July 08:03 PDT is when the backlog of incident-window events finished processing, so it is excluded; the 27 Jul 13:47 PDT update also says mitigated for a majority of users. Early status updates gave a start of 08:30 Pacific; the mini report's 06:30 is used. Stated duration (4 days, 1 hour, 33 minutes) not coded since a start and end pair is given.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report gives the incident start as 17 July 09:56 Pacific. End: Mini report and resolution notice both place the end at 14:28 Pacific that day. Regions: Mini report lists the location as Global; the failures are described as global.
notes: Scope global because the mini report lists Regions/Zones: Global. Region codes are taken from the page's previously affected locations list; that list also names the Google Cloud multi-regions 'eu' and 'us', which get no code. A status update earlier gave the start as 11:00 Pacific; the mini report's 09:56 is used. Mitigated by rolling back recent changes.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report puts the start on 13 July at 07:55 Pacific. End: Mini report gives the incident end as 21 July 02:29 Pacific. Regions: Mini report names eight regions, from asia-northeast2 and me-west1 to several US regions.
notes: Regions from the mini report's Regions/Zones line (8 regions); the page's affected-location header lists only 6 of them (omits me-west1 and us-east5). Impact was limited to update operations on instances created before 14 July 2023; instance usage was not affected. Regions were mitigated one by one, with us-east1 last; no per-region start is given. Resolution notice states 02:55 Pacific; the mini report's 02:29 incident end is used.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report shows the incident starting 10 July at 09:38 Pacific. End: Mini report lists the end as 11:28 Pacific the same day. Regions: Location given as Global; management plane failed in every region.
notes: No region codes: the only location named is Global. Only the Media CDN management API (configuration changes) was impaired; the data plane serving HTTP traffic was unaffected. The page header also names Google Cloud Networking as an affected category, but the mini report names only Media CDN, so services_n is 1. Resolution notice states 11:37 Pacific; the mini report's 11:28 is used.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report and status updates put the start at 09:19 Pacific on 10 July. End: Mini report and resolution notice give 13:29 Pacific as the end. Regions: Mini report lists Global; the incident title is also prefixed Global.
notes: Scope global because the mini report lists Regions/Zones: Global. Region codes come from the page's previously affected locations list (21 regions). Mitigated by rolling back an access management configuration change.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report puts the start on 6 July at 07:13 Pacific. End: Mini report and resolution notice give 18 July 07:27 Pacific, after the gradual fix rollout. Regions: Mini report lists Global.
notes: Scope global because the mini report lists Regions/Zones: Global; region codes come from the page's previously affected locations list (37 regions). Impaired feature is GKE logging (extra log messages, Logging API quota exhaustion for a subset); workloads were not affected. The 10 Jul 2023 update says quota concerns for large workloads were already mitigated, but extra messages continued until the fix rollout completed.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report gives 4 July 18:47 Pacific as the start, for us-central1. End: Mini report gives 21:03 Pacific that evening as the end. Regions: Mini report names us-central1 plus three regions hit briefly and intermittently.
notes: Times in Pacific are 4 July 2023, which is 5 July in UTC. europe-west2, europe-west9 and asia-south1 saw about 5 minutes of intermittent impact within a window from 20:11 to 21:03 PDT; region_starts use the window start of 20:11 PDT. Status updates gave 19:00 Pacific as the start for us-central1; the mini report's 18:47 is used. Resolution notice states 21:09 Pacific.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report puts the start at 10:15 Pacific on 26 June. End: Mini report gives an end of 11:04 Pacific, after traffic was redirected away from bad IAM workloads. Regions: Authentication failures hit many services across us-east5.
notes: Zone us-east5-c is named only for Compute Engine impact (about half of users, 10:21 to 11:05 Pacific); other services are described for the region as a whole, so scope regional. Services counted are the eight listed as affected: Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Pub/Sub Lite, Bigtable, Data Catalog, Compute Engine, Spanner, Cloud Storage; Cloud IAM is the cause and is not counted. Cloud Storage impact is given as 10:20 to 11:09 Pacific, slightly past the stated incident end. Resolution notice states 11:06 Pacific.

evidence: Start: Incident Report summary says intermittent 403 errors began 19 June at 07:29 Pacific. End: Remediation section says services fully recovered at 14:14 Pacific that day. Regions: Report names us-west1 and the US multi-region.
notes: Published date is the full Incident Report (28 Jun 2023); a Mini Incident Report was posted 20 Jun 2023. The Google Cloud multi-region 'us' is also affected (Cloud Storage) but is not a region and gets no code. The page's affected-location header also lists europe-west1 and us-west2, and an early update mentioned us-west2, but neither report section names them as impacted, so they are not coded. Status updates gave starts of 07:30 and 07:38 Pacific; the reports' 07:29 is used. Resolution notice states 14:13 Pacific.

evidence: Start: First impact window, in asia-southeast1, opens at 07:35 Pacific on 6 June. End: Last window, in europe-west1, closes at 08:35 Pacific. Regions: Mini report gives three separate windows in three named regions.
notes: Mini report gives three impact windows: asia-southeast1 07:35 to 07:58, asia-east1 08:02 to 08:18, europe-west1 08:08 to 08:35 PDT; start and end span all three. Services counted: Cloud VPN, Cloud NAT and Virtual Private Cloud, listed under Google Cloud Networking, which is treated as the umbrella and not counted separately. Resolution notice states 08:47 Pacific.
